decisions.reason: As a 2023 laser product that extends the established portfolio, it has enough development investment and two years of market presence to encourage continuation, even if its relatively modest web prominence makes it somewhat easier to withdraw than the more visibly promoted launches.
This printer is close to the firm's core offer and was given its own product page in both years, so sunk development costs and clear public commitment make management likely to persist with it.
Because it is a close-to-core inkjet product with dedicated web presentation over two years, management is likely to justify and continue the investment unless results become clearly untenable.
A 2024 launch placed on the home page signals strong public commitment and strategic relevance to the firm's marking and traceability direction, which makes near-term withdrawal unlikely.

The explicitly announced new laser cabin builds directly on the existing laser business, and its recent launch gives management room to attribute any weak early results to normal market ramp-up rather than failure.
Although this more specialized system had lighter website exposure, the trade-fair award provides external validation and reputational commitment, reinforcing a decision to stay the course.
